candlesticks.title: 📊 Candlestick Charts
candlesticks.body: Each candle shows the open, high, low, and close price for a time period. A green (bullish) candle means price closed higher than it opened. A red (bearish) candle means price closed lower. The wicks (thin lines) show the highest and lowest price reached during that period.

bollingerBands.title: 📉 Bollinger Bands
bollingerBands.body: Three lines plotted around price: a 20-period simple moving average (middle), and upper/lower bands 2 standard deviations away. When price approaches the upper band, the asset may be overbought. Near the lower band suggests oversold conditions. Narrow bands signal low volatility; wide bands signal high volatility.

rsi.title: 💪 RSI — Relative Strength Index
rsi.body: RSI measures momentum on a 0–100 scale. Above 70 = overbought (potential sell signal). Below 30 = oversold (potential buy signal). Between 30–70 is neutral territory. RSI divergence — when price makes a new high but RSI doesn't — can signal a reversal.

macd.title: 📈 MACD
macd.body: Moving Average Convergence Divergence tracks momentum using two EMAs (12 and 26 period). When the MACD line crosses above the signal line, it's a bullish signal. Below = bearish. The histogram shows the difference between the two lines. Positive = bullish momentum, negative = bearish.

supportResistance.title: 🧱 Support & Resistance
supportResistance.body: Support is a price level where buying interest is strong enough to stop a decline — price tends to 'bounce' off it. Resistance is the opposite: a ceiling where selling pressure stops price from rising. Once broken, these levels often flip roles (support becomes resistance and vice versa).

openInterest.title: 📂 Open Interest
openInterest.body: Open Interest (OI) is the total number of outstanding futures/options contracts that haven't been settled. Rising OI with rising price = strong bullish trend. Rising OI with falling price = strong bearish trend. Falling OI usually means positions are being closed (trend weakening).

fundingRate.title: 💰 Funding Rate
fundingRate.body: In perpetual futures, the funding rate is a periodic payment between longs and shorts to keep the contract price close to the spot price. Positive funding = longs pay shorts (market is bullish, longs are dominant). Negative = shorts pay longs (bearish sentiment). Extreme funding rates often precede reversals.

longShort.title: ⚖️ Long / Short Ratio
longShort.body: Shows the ratio of traders holding long vs short positions. A ratio above 1 means more longs than shorts — bullish sentiment. Below 1 = bearish sentiment. Counter-intuitively, extreme ratios (e.g. 3:1 longs) can signal a reversal as the market often moves against the crowd.

liquidations.title: 💥 Liquidations
liquidations.body: A liquidation happens when a leveraged trader's position is forcibly closed because their margin is insufficient to cover losses. Mass liquidations cause rapid price spikes — a cascade of long liquidations pushes price sharply down; short liquidations push it sharply up. The heatmap shows estimated liquidation clusters.

leverage.title: ⚡ Leverage & Risk
leverage.body: Leverage amplifies both gains and losses. At 10× leverage, a 10% price move wipes your entire position. The liquidation price is approximately: Entry × (1 − 1/Leverage) for longs, Entry × (1 + 1/Leverage) for shorts. Always use stop-losses, size positions conservatively, and never risk more than you can afford to lose.

buySell.title: Buy / Sell Zones
buySell.body: Buy zones are price areas near strong support or the lower Bollinger Band where price is likely to find buyers. Sell zones are near resistance or the upper band where sellers tend to step in. These are confluence areas — the more indicators agree (support + oversold RSI + lower BB), the stronger the signal.

riskReward.title: 📐 Risk / Reward Ratio
riskReward.body: R/R = (Take Profit distance) ÷ (Stop Loss distance). A 1:2 ratio means you risk $1 to make $2. Most professional traders aim for at least 1:2. Even with a 40% win rate, a consistent 1:2 R/R is profitable over time. Never enter a trade with an R/R below 1:1.

ai.ctaText: AI-powered cycle analysis — cycle phase, 6-month and 12-month outlooks, key levels, and an actionable long-term take, powered by GPT-4o.

monthly.how: Each cell shows Bitcoin's percentage return for that calendar month. Rows are years, columns are months. Deeper green = larger gain, deeper red = larger loss. This heatmap reveals seasonal patterns — which months have historically been strong or weak across multiple market cycles.
monthly.earlyAccumulation: {{months}} months into the current post-halving cycle (Early Accumulation phase). Q4 and Q1 in post-halving years have historically been Bitcoin's strongest quarters. October through March tends to concentrate the largest monthly gains — compare those columns to 2020 and 2016 for confirmation.
monthly.midExpansion: {{months}} months into the current post-halving cycle (Mid Expansion phase). Mid-cycle years show strong green clusters in Q3–Q4. Look for the current year's October–December columns matching the same period in 2020 and 2016 as the historical template.
monthly.lateExpansion: {{months}} months into the current post-halving cycle (Late Expansion phase). Late-cycle monthly returns become erratic — alternating between sharp gains and sudden red months. High monthly volatility with declining volume on green months is a distribution signal.
monthly.distribution: {{months}} months into the current post-halving cycle (Distribution phase). Distribution phases show a shift from green-dominated to red-dominated columns. Isolated green months appear as relief rallies against a bearish backdrop — compare to 2021 Q3–Q4.
monthly.bearMarket: {{months}} months into the current post-halving cycle (Bear Market phase). Bear markets show persistent red. Watch January and October historically — they have the highest frequency of cycle-bottom reversals or the start of recovery months.
monthly.recovery: {{months}} months into the current post-halving cycle (Recovery phase). Recovery phases see the first clusters of consistent monthly greens returning. Low-volume base building accelerates as the next halving approaches — compare to 2019 and 2015.

ma200.how: The 200-Week Moving Average is Bitcoin's most-watched long-term support. Price has never closed a full week below this level without eventually recovering to new all-time highs. Touching or trading below the 200W MA has been a generational buy zone in every prior cycle; trading above 3× has preceded every major top.
ma200.below: Price is trading below the 200W MA ({{ma200}}) — an extreme buy zone seen only at cycle lows. Every prior occurrence was followed by a full recovery to new highs.{{comp}}
ma200.earlyBull: At {{ratio}}× the 200W MA ({{ma200}}), Bitcoin is in the early-bull range. There is significant room before the historically elevated zone above 3×.{{comp}}
ma200.midBull: At {{ratio}}× the 200W MA ({{ma200}}), Bitcoin is in healthy mid-bull expansion territory. Both the 2017 and 2021 tops occurred above 3×.{{comp}}
ma200.approaching: At {{ratio}}× the 200W MA ({{ma200}}), Bitcoin is approaching the historically elevated zone. Prior tops occurred near or above 3× — monitor for distribution signals.{{comp}}
ma200.stretched: At {{ratio}}× the 200W MA ({{ma200}}), Bitcoin is in the historically stretched zone. Both prior cycle tops were followed by 70–85% drawdowns from this territory.{{comp}}
ma200.comp: At the same week in the 2020 cycle (week {{wks}}), the ratio was {{r2020}}×.

cycle.how: Both the 2020 and 2024 cycles are normalized to 100% at their respective halving dates, then plotted week-by-week on the same axis. This removes absolute price noise and reveals the structural shape of each cycle — whether the current one is running hot, cold, or in line with the prior bull market.
cycle.noData: Week {{wks}} post-halving — comparing the current 2024 cycle against the 2020 cycle at the same point in time.
cycle.tracking: Week {{wks}} post-halving: the 2024 cycle has gained {{gain24}}% from its halving price. At this same week, the 2020 cycle was up {{gain20}}%. The current cycle is closely tracking the 2020 analogue.
cycle.outperforming: Week {{wks}} post-halving: the 2024 cycle has gained {{gain24}}% from its halving price. At this same week, the 2020 cycle was up {{gain20}}%. The current cycle is outperforming the 2020 analogue by {{diff}} percentage points.
cycle.trailing: Week {{wks}} post-halving: the 2024 cycle has gained {{gain24}}% from its halving price. At this same week, the 2020 cycle was up {{gain20}}%. The current cycle is trailing the 2020 analogue by {{diff}} percentage points.

pi.how: The Pi Cycle Top tracks two moving averages — the 111-day SMA (≈16-week) and twice the 350-day SMA (≈2×50-week). When the faster line crosses above the slower, it has marked the cycle top within days in every prior Bitcoin bull run: December 2017, April 2021, and November 2021.
pi.warning: ⚠ Warning: the 16W SMA is only {{gap}}% above the 2×50W SMA — the lines are converging. Historically, a cross has fired within days of cycle tops (Dec 2017, Apr 2021, Nov 2021). Watch closely.
pi.converging: The lines are converging with a gap of only {{gap}}%. No cross yet, but the proximity warrants attention at week {{wks}} in the cycle.
pi.above: The 16W SMA is {{gap}}% above the 2×50W SMA at week {{wks}}. The lines are diverging — no imminent top signal. This indicator typically fires in the late-expansion or distribution phase.
pi.below: The 16W SMA is {{gap}}% below the 2×50W SMA at week {{wks}}. No Pi Cycle Top signal — lines are clearly separated. The indicator is inactive and a cross is not imminent.

fib.how: Fibonacci retracement and extension levels are measured from the current cycle low to the all-time high. The 0.618 Golden Ratio and 0.786 levels are the most critical retracement supports on corrections. The 1.618 and 2.618 extensions above the ATH are the primary cycle-top target zones in prior Bitcoin bull markets.
fib.aboveATH: Price is above the ATH — in extension territory. The 1.618 ({{ext1618}}) and 2.618 ({{ext2618}}) levels are the primary cycle-top target zones in prior Bitcoin bull markets.
fib.belowATH: Price is {{pct}}% below the ATH ({{ath}}). A confirmed break above opens extension targets at 1.618 ({{ext1618}}) and 2.618 ({{ext2618}}).

scenario.how: Three forward price paths are projected from the current cycle week: Bull (new ATH driven by institutional demand and ETF flows), Base (steady accumulation without a major macro catalyst), and Bear (macro shock or distribution retracement to Fibonacci support). Paths are shaped by historical cycle analogues and current Fibonacci targets.
scenario.earlyAccumulation: Historical analogues show the strongest price appreciation leg typically begins 6–18 months post-halving. The base case projects steady gains before the main expansion phase.
scenario.midExpansion: Mid-expansion is Bitcoin's historically strongest phase. Analogues from 2020–2021 and 2016–2017 show sharp momentum moves interspersed with 20–40% corrections before the final leg.
scenario.lateExpansion: Late expansion is marked by increasing volatility and the start of distribution. Prior cycles peaked in this window — the gap between the Bull and Bear targets is widest here.
scenario.distribution: Prior cycles topped in the distribution phase and then entered 18–24 month bear markets. The Bear path reflects what prior drops looked like in magnitude and pace.
scenario.bearMarket: Bear markets typically last 12–18 months from the peak. Accumulation zones near the 200W MA and 0.618 Fibonacci level have historically been generational entry points.
scenario.recovery: Recovery phases transition to early accumulation — lower volatility, rising volume, and the first signs of renewed demand before the next halving sets up a new cycle.

onboarding.welcomeSub: Answer 4 quick questions so we can personalise your dashboard and surface the signals that matter most to you.

questions.title: How long have you been in crypto?
questions.subtitle: We'll tailor the dashboard to your experience level.

questions.title: What's your typical position size?
questions.subtitle: Helps us contextualise liquidation and risk data.

questions.title: Which tools do you actively use?
questions.subtitle: Select all that apply — pick as many as you want.

questions.title: What's your primary strategy?
questions.subtitle: No wrong answers — just helps us frame the data.

levels.label: Beginner
levels.desc: You're just getting started. We'll highlight the most important signals and keep the noise down so you can build confidence step by step.

levels.label: Intermediate
levels.desc: You've got the basics down. We'll surface deeper market signals, funding rate context, and multi-timeframe analysis.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.desc: You know your way around. Full data access, all tools unlocked — liquidation maps, on-chain metrics, Gann analysis.

levels.label: Expert
levels.desc: You eat liquidation heatmaps for breakfast. Maximum data density, zero hand-holding, pure signal.

predModal.title: AI Prediction · {{coin}} · {{interval}}
predModal.bullDivDesc: Price made a lower low while RSI made a higher low — momentum is strengthening despite the price drop, signaling a potential reversal upward.
predModal.bearDivDesc: Price made a higher high while RSI made a lower high — momentum is weakening despite the price rise, signaling a potential reversal downward.

priceTicker.insightSteady: {{coin}} is holding steady — no movement since you opened this view.
priceTicker.insightUp: {{coin}} is up {{pct}}% since open — buyers in control, price pushing higher.
priceTicker.insightDown: {{coin}} is down {{pct}}% since open — sellers applying pressure at current levels.

ai.title: AI Price Prediction
ai.desc: Institutional-grade analysis combining price action, funding rates, volume, RSI, and liquidation data into a single directional call with price targets.

heatmap.title: Liquidation Heatmap
heatmap.desc: Visualizes where leveraged positions will be force-liquidated. These clusters act as price magnets — markets routinely sweep liquidity zones before reversing, giving you predictable entry and exit points.

feargreed.title: Fear & Greed Index
feargreed.desc: A composite of six market signals measuring crowd emotion in real time. Historically, extreme fear marks the best buying opportunities and extreme greed signals increased risk of correction.

onchain.title: On-Chain Metrics
onchain.desc: Tracks what wallets are actually doing on the blockchain — not what analysts are saying. Exchange outflows, whale accumulation, and miner behavior consistently lead price by days or weeks.

alerts.title: Price Alerts
alerts.desc: Define trigger conditions once and let the market come to you. Never miss a key breakout, support test, or indicator crossover again — get notified the moment conditions are met.

etf.title: ETF Inflows & Outflows
etf.desc: Bitcoin spot ETFs now channel billions in institutional demand directly into the market. Days of strong inflows historically correlate with price appreciation; sustained outflows signal distribution.

positions.title: Long / Short Positions
positions.desc: Shows the ratio of longs to shorts across major derivatives exchanges. When everyone is positioned the same way, the market punishes them — extreme imbalances are powerful contrarian signals.

htf.title: Higher Timeframe Analysis
htf.desc: Weekly and monthly structure defines where price is ultimately heading. Trading in the direction of the macro trend on HTF dramatically improves win rates on lower-timeframe entries.

orderflow.title: Order Flow
orderflow.desc: The real-time tape of large trades hitting the book. Aggressive institutional orders reveal conviction before price reacts — giving you a window into what smart money is doing right now.

signals.title: AI Signals
signals.desc: Multi-exchange consensus signals that filter noise from true momentum. Combines funding rates, RSI, MACD, volume profile, and liquidation data across exchanges into clear, actionable calls.

fundingbot.title: AI Funding Bot
fundingbot.desc: Perpetual futures funding rates reveal leverage extremes in real time. Crowded longs paying 0.05%+ per 8h (over 50% annualized) almost always precede a flush. Shorts trapped in negative rates set up violent squeezes.

gann.title: Gann Analysis
gann.desc: W.D. Gann's geometric price/time relationships identify high-probability reversal zones that most traders never see. When price and time square off, reversals become highly probable.

candleai.title: AI Candle Watcher
candleai.desc: Real-time candlestick analysis powered by AI. Reads every candle, identifies what market makers are doing, and calls the next move with key levels to watch.

markets.title: Global Markets
markets.desc: Real-time overview of major crypto markets — prices, 24h changes, market caps and volume across hundreds of assets. Spot opportunities and compare performance across sectors at a glance.

altanalysis.title: Alt Coin Analysis
altanalysis.desc: Deep-dive AI-powered analysis for alternative cryptocurrencies. Combines price action, technical indicators, funding rates, and BTC macro context to generate directional predictions with price targets.

fundingBot.title: AI Funding Bot
fundingBot.subtitle: Live perpetual funding rates across top coins. Powered by OKX.
fundingBot.networkError: Network error — could not reach AI service.
fundingBot.errorLoad: Failed to load funding data. Please try again.
fundingBot.tipOverheatedBody: {{sym}} longs are paying {{rate}}/8h ({{annual}}% annualized). The market is overcrowded to the upside — leverage is extreme and cascading liquidations become likely on any drop.
fundingBot.tipOverheatedAction: Carry trade: short the perp, buy spot (delta-neutral). Or wait for the flush before entering longs.
fundingBot.tipElevatedLongBody: {{sym}} longs are paying {{rate}}/8h. Sentiment is bullish and building, but not yet at dangerous extremes. Rate could continue rising if momentum holds.
fundingBot.tipElevatedLongAction: Momentum favors longs, but tighten stops — if rate spikes further, a squeeze becomes likely.
fundingBot.tipTrappedBody: {{sym}} shorts are paying longs {{rate}}/8h ({{annual}}% annualized). Bears are overcrowded — every 8h the shorts bleed more, increasing short squeeze pressure significantly.
fundingBot.tipTrappedAction: Carry trade: long the perp, short spot. Or watch for violent short squeeze as weak shorts capitulate.
fundingBot.tipElevatedShortBody: {{sym}} shorts are paying {{rate}}/8h. Bearish sentiment is elevated — market is skewing short but not yet at extreme levels.
fundingBot.tipElevatedShortAction: Oversold conditions building. Watch for longs to step in — bounces can be sharp when shorts are crowded.
fundingBot.tipNeutralBody: {{sym}} funding rate is near zero ({{rate}}%). Neither longs nor shorts are overcrowded — the market is fairly neutral on leverage.
fundingBot.tipNeutralAction: No funding-based edge. Look at price action, RSI, and liquidation clusters for direction.
